name: Kuromori Suzu
source:
Suzu is the bassist and primary composer of Kimisaki Academy's Rock Band Club. Infected with chuunibyou, she often calls herself "Clochette". She affectionately refers to [url=/c98205]Ruka[/url] as "Luca" and [url=/c98264]Shizuku[/url] as "Shizu". She often brainstorms catchphrases together with her frequently hospitalized friend [url=/c98613]Seira[/url], who she refers to as "Sera".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
